SELECT

    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p_any.attempt > 1 THEN p.bill_id END) AS retried,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p_any.attempt > 1 THEN p.bill_id END) AS gave_up_zero
FROM payments.pos_payments p

WHERE p.ts >= '2026-06-01' AND p.ts < '2026-07-01'
  AND p.attempt = 1 
  AND p.till_status IN ('declined', 'failed', 'failed: no response');

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.bill_id) AS total_failed_first,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p_success.bill_id IS NOT NULL THEN p.bill_id END) AS eventually_approved,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.bill_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p_success.bill_id IS NOT NULL THEN p.bill_id END) AS gave_up
FROM payments.pos_payments p
LEFT JOIN payments.pos_payments p_success 
    ON p.bill_id = p_success.bill_id AND p_success.till_status = 'approved'
WHERE p.ts >= '2026-06-01' AND p.ts < '2026-07-01'
  AND p.attempt = 1 
  AND p.till_status IN ('declined', 'failed', 'failed: no response');

GROUP BY p.bill_id
